name: proxmox
description: Manage Proxmox VE nodes, VMs, and containers. Lists hardware stats and resources, controls power states (start, stop, reboot, shutdown), and manages snapshots (create, list, rollback, delete).

env.name: PVE_HOST
env.description: Proxmox VE host URL, e.g. https://pve.local:8006

env.name: PVE_TOKEN_ID
env.description: API token ID in the form user@realm!tokenname, e.g. openclaw@pve!bot-token

env.name: PVE_TOKEN_SECRET
env.description: API token secret value generated by Proxmox when the token was created.
